reasons: Correct classification: p0125 imposes a one-way, three-year non-solicit on the Licensee (our party) covering every Licensor and Affiliate employee, which fails the fallback on duration (>24 months) and scope (all Vendor personnel) and sits in walk-away territory.

Redline reaches the fallback with targeted edits — mutual obligation, scope limited to personnel directly involved in performance, 12 months running from the end of that involvement — and preserves the existing general-advertising/unsolicited-inquiry carve-out; no no-hire language exists to delete.

The failed duration regex is a formatting artifact: the redline states 'twelve (12) month period', which satisfies the ≤12-month requirement. The 0.573 changed-character ratio is justified because duration, scope and mutuality all had to be rewritten in a single sentence.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, and correctly cites the playbook position; the note about the injunctive-relief cross-reference is properly handled as informational rather than a second flag.
